activity.notes: This is a c.1632 HISTORICAL REPRESENTATIVE POINT for the appointment and political leadership of Leonor, a woman born at the El Limón maroon settlement near Cartagena, supported by groups from Polín and Malemba communities. María Cristina Navarrete, using 17th-century Archivo General de Indias testimonies, identifies Leonor's election and involvement in defense while Francisco continued serving as military captain. Identical year boundaries DO NOT mean she ruled only for one year. The precise beginning/end of her tenure and her date of death remain unknown; the community's destruction must not be recorded as her death. The polity is a specific self-governing maroon settlement, not all Palenques or the later town of San Basilio.
